TheQuickening.description: Targets a hex within movement range {[range]} that is neither occupied by an enemy nor by a friendly unit in <style="Teleport_Strike_short">Deep Strike</style>. <style="Faction_BloodAngels">Mephiston</style> moves onto that hex. If a friendly unit is on that hex, that unit moves to Mephiston's previous location. All <style="Faction_BloodAngels">Blood Angels</style> moving this way perform a <style="NormalAttack">normal melee attack</style> after they move, dealing <style="STAT">{[dmgPct]}%</style> of their own damage to a maximum of <style="Stat_Damage">{[maxDmg]} Damage</style>. Units moving this way do not trigger <style="Buff_Overwatching">Overwatch</style> or other movement related reactions.
